AND sale_status=1 AND starttime > NOW()
AND h.start LIKE CONCAT('%', #{start}, '%')
AND h.`end` LIKE CONCAT('%', #{end}, '%')
AND h.starttime >= #{starttime} AND h.starttime < DATE_ADD(#{starttime}, INTERVAL 1 DAY)
ORDER BY h.starttime ASC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
